query_scope: pg_catalog and pg_policies metadata only; no customer rows queried
query: SELECT public base table counts; RLS and FORCE RLS flags; count tables without policies; has_table_privilege checks for anon/authenticated SELECT and INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE
interpretation: All 115 public base tables in both environments report RLS enabled and FORCE RLS enabled.
33 tables in each environment have no policies.
Catalog privilege checks report no anon or authenticated SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE grants on those no-policy tables.
This reduces the immediate concern raised by advisor INFO findings but does not prove tenant isolation or full database security.
The query does not inspect service_role exposure, function EXECUTE grants, SECURITY DEFINER behavior, storage policies, schema object parity, or application-mediated access.
limitations: Read-only catalog metadata only; no customer data queried.
No writes, migrations, settings changes or destructive operations.
Function ACL query was not completed; function grants remain unverified.
Identical aggregate counts do not establish identical table definitions, constraints, indexes, policies or data.
